boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten named gardens and outdoor spaces at nearby Elizabeth Park for an admission-free daytime walk, conversation, or photo stop.

cards.title: Walk the Helen S Kaman Rose Garden
cards.subtitle: Elizabeth Park · West Hartford, near Trinity College
cards.notes: Meet by the rose arches, take an unhurried loop through the beds, and use the benches for a low-key daytime catch-up.
cards.short_summary: A named public rose garden for a no-cost outdoor stroll.
cards.evidence_claim: Elizabeth Park is free to the public with no admission fees; the Helen S Kaman Rose Garden is a named garden there.
cards.source_title: Elizabeth Park Conservancy — Welcome to Elizabeth Park
cards.access_notes: Open 365 days a year, dawn to dusk. The Conservancy states there are no admission fees.
